tags.feature: - New class icons have been added to the Guild window.

tags.feature: - Boss Rush event map has been added to the game.

notes.title: 31.05.2025 - New Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559336/5ab3ead9e6396638ef7535c98091b90c27ee7166.png[/img]

[General]
- Costumes and elephant mounts obtained from daily rewards can no longer be traded.
- Several translation errors have been fixed.
- Bronze and Silver Arena medals that can no longer be obtained are now unusable.
- EXP Scrolls can now be stacked.
- Improvements were made regarding movable windows appearing in front of the screen.

[Event]
- Preparations have been made for the Eid al-Adha event.
 + During the event, you can receive daily event quests from the Event Manager NPC.
 + Hunt Wild Ox in any grinding map and collect Sacrificial Meat. Exchange quest rewards for premium items and a rare gathering pet.
 + Event start date: June 6, End date: June 21 at 23:59 Server Time.

[Map]
- Grinding spots in the Aztec Temple map have been made more efficient.
- Grinding spots in the Narakha Basin map have been improved.
- A new map, Lost Coast, has been added to the game.

[Quest]
- A new daily quest has been added to the Grand Fortress Quest Board for levels 70–85.

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where characters would stand up when typing while sitting.
- Fixed a visual bug where wizards appeared larger after exiting their house.
- In the Golden Fish event, player positions are now completely randomized.
- Players kicked from a clan will now also be removed from the clan castle.
- Dark-level players now gain less EXP from non-dark monsters.
- Players you ignore can no longer send you friend requests.
- Family messages no longer interrupt your character’s movement.

[Visual]
- Visual adjustments made to Dark Lord weapons.
- Streamer name tag has been updated.
- The remaining time window for planted seeds has been renewed.

[Voice Acting]
- Turkish voice acting has been added to the game.

[Farming]
- Upon logging in, if your field crops are fully grown, you will now receive a system message.

[Balance]
- Some changes have been made to the Ranger class:
 + Void Bomb is now a skill that originates from the character. Stun duration reduced from 1.6 to 1.5 seconds.
 + The stun area of Void Bomb has been reduced to match the size of the Arrow Spin skill.
 + Shock Bomb’s stun chance increased from 60% to 100% (excluding stun resistance or miss).
 + Shock Bomb’s stun duration increased from 1 second to 1.6 seconds.
 + The shout sound effect of Ground Strike has been changed.
Reason: The adjustments were made to reference the archer, as having two AOE stun skills made dodging with dash nearly impossible.

[AI]
- AI systems have been improved with Lilith AI v2.
- The translation system now performs better.

[Blacksmith]
- Materials required to upgrade items +4 and above have been updated in line with the new item dismantling system.

[System]
- Dungeon end cards will now change color based on the rarity of the obtained item.
- You can now browse markets within your field of view more easily via the market window.
- An auto-walk system has been added for mobile devices.
- Market owner names will now appear in purple until they leave the map.
- PC players can now press ` to auto-target enemies.
- Private chat windows have been added to the game.
- You can message someone with /chat nickname or chat with players from your friends list and markets via dedicated chat windows.
- A new item dismantling system has been added. You can now destroy any item at the blacksmith to obtain materials required for upgrading.
- For upgrades +5 and above, you must obtain items from the dismantling system.
- If you are upgrading SSR items, you can dismantle unwanted SSRs to obtain SSR Dust.
- This system is designed to increase the value of low-tier SSR items and equipment in the market.

[AC Shop]
- Thunder Lucky Box has been added to the AC Shop for a limited time.
- Fog Clan set has been permanently added to the AC Shop.

notes.title: Update Notes - 11.02.2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559336/225efd8693d6b75c0478c52b9c52702c618a97ab.png[/img]

[General]
- Daily rewards have been updated.
- Items in the daily reward panel are now clickable.
- Lucky Wheel rewards have been updated.
- Adjustments have been made to the Patcher screen.
- Wooden Dummies have been added near the blacksmith in Honam Kingdom. You can perform damage tests on the dummies.
- You can now see players' levels in the selection panel.
- A button has been added to the user selection panel to allow sending PMs.
- You can now get up from the seats using the jump button.
- Some issues where your movement was interrupted by clicking on certain windows have been fixed.

[Dungeons]
- A dungeon difficulty system has been added to the game, with Normal, Hard, and Abyss dungeon difficulties now available.
 + In Hard dungeons, experience and drops are doubled, but monsters are also twice as strong. Rating rewards are luckier than normal.
 + In Abyss dungeons, experience and drops are tripled, but monsters are three times as strong. Rating rewards are luckier than Hard.
 + Hard and Abyss dungeons require higher fees after their card draw rights are filled.

[Visual Effects]
- The visual effect for the Wizard class’s Perfect level Holy Beam ability has been improved.

[Items]
- Starting SSR items have been slightly strengthened.
- Precious Sapphire Crystal can now be obtained from Lapis Blue and Flaming Red mystery boxes.
- Golden Coin (1B) can now be stacked.
- The purchase price for Golden Coin (1B) has been increased from 1B to 1B.5M.
- Faction Change (Balance) item has been added to the Premium Trader NPC.
- You can switch sides when the opposing side is weaker. Hero and Villain transitions will open and close periodically based on balance. If you cannot switch when you buy the item, you can resell it for 10k less.

[Party]
- The party experience earning system has been updated.
- The experience from monsters you kill will no longer be divided.
- You will earn an additional 4% experience for each person you grind near in the party.
- If you're grinding at a distance, you will only receive the 4% experience bonus.
- The party experience sharing distance has been increased from 80 meters to 100 meters.
- You can benefit from bonuses using the Party Finder system.

- Red Clan hair issue has been fixed.
- Some players were standing after death; this issue has been resolved.
- Missing "Craftable" text on SSR Dark Helmet item has been added.
- Players who die in Puppet mode will now fall to the ground.

[System]
- You will now be immune to monster attacks for 3 seconds after respawning.
- A feature has been added to allow changing skill sensitivity on mobile.

[Combat]
- Poison Cloud ability has been added as an extra ability for certain bosses.

[Interface]
- An event indicator showing active events has been added to the interface.
- An interface button has been added to click on NPCs on PC.

[Stalls]
- Normal markets will remain active for 30 minutes after logging out.
- Stalls can no longer be placed within 2 meters of each other.
- If you enable the "Offer Only" setting while setting up your market, you will only receive offers.

[Drop Rate]
- The drop rate for creatures on the Hellmond map has been increased.

[Optimization]
- In-game optimizations have been made.
- Game size has been optimized.

[AC Shop]
- Holy Bless item has been added to the AC Shop.
- Holy Bless prevents you from losing experience on your next death.
- Moonlit Pair costume set has been temporarily added to the AC Shop.
- Magician Hat has been temporarily added to the AC Shop.
- Hunter costume set has been permanently added to the AC Shop.
- Froggy Raincoat costume set has been permanently added to the AC Shop.
- Traditional Honam costume set has been permanently added to the AC Shop.

notes.title: New Character Models and More! - Update v1.2.93
notes.content:
[General]
- The game icon has been updated.

[Movement 2.0 - Beta]
- The character movement system has been rewritten to behave more consistently under different ping levels, reducing teleportation issues.
  + Previously, in laggy situations, when characters were forcibly stopped while using skills, their positions were sometimes fixed to an earlier point due to latency differences, causing teleportation issues. Now, lagging players will continue to progress toward their actual positions while using skills, reducing teleportation problems.
  + If significant issues occur, the previous movement system will be reinstated.

[Visual]
- Character models have been redesigned.
- The positioning of wings on the back has been fixed.
- Wings now grow larger as they are upgraded.
- Houses have been redesigned.
- House furnishings have been redesigned.
- The weapon sizes for the Warrior class have been adjusted, resolving the issue of weapons clipping into the ground.
- The texture quality of ground patterns in the Honam Kingdom map has been improved.
- The proportions of house models in the Honam Kingdom map have been corrected.
- Character running animations will now speed up based on running speed.

[Performance]
- In-game optimizations have been implemented.
- Game responsiveness, including abilities like dash, has been improved.

[System]
- When viewing the character from the front, the character will now look at the screen.
- A cancel button has been added to the furniture placement system in houses.
- Settings related to Puppet mode will now be saved.
- If you re-enter the game within 1 hour of logging out, your bonuses will no longer be lost.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559336/550b581855af1f350b2ed47e9ab9ff20a44af79f.png[/img]

[Event]
- The more monsters you kill during your game session, the higher the drop bonus you will earn (Max +30%).
- The more time you spend in the game during your session, the higher the EXP bonus you will gain (Max +30%).
- If you log out, the extra bonuses will reset. You can view your bonus amount from the game stats icon in your character panel. This event has been permanently added to the game. You can check the bonus details from the game statistics icon in the stats panel.
  + Note: If you get disconnected or accidentally log out, your bonuses will not reset as long as you reconnect within 10 minutes.

[Game Engine]
- The game engine has been updated, and performance optimizations have been made.
  + If you encounter any issues, please report them to anisagesmtp@gmail.com, and they will be resolved as soon as possible!

[General]
- A chat notification will now appear when someone from your friends list comes online.
- You can now purchase Radish seeds from Farmer Sophia.
- The Golden Coin (1B) item has been added to Antique Dealer Mike to help with transactions requiring more than 2B gold storage.
- An arrow indicator has been added to your own market to mark it as yours.
- Dark-level players can now shop from Elf Sekiro on the Narakha map.
- The patcher download system has been changed (In-game synchronous download has been added).

- Pink Demon Costumes have been added to the AC Shop.
- Traditional Honam Kingdom Costumes have been removed from the AC Shop.

[Craft]
- SSR Master Dark Draconian Mask has been added to the Craft Panel.

[Deathmatch Arena (Ranked)]
- Pet names have been hidden in the Deathmatch Arena.
- The player placement algorithm in the Deathmatch Arena has been updated.

[Raid]
- In family raids, if you lose your internet connection or get disconnected from the game, you will not lose your attempt.
- A fix has been made for the issue where monsters would not spawn in some raids.

[Items]
- Fishing Rune and Golden Meat items are now tradable.
- The issue where items would not stack after reaching 999 in the inventory has been fixed.

[Cooking]
- You can now cook multiple dishes at once. (Max: 10)

[System]
- A button has been added to the map panel to view the list of items dropped by monsters on your current map.
- A setting has been added to the game settings to toggle the visual effects of shaking and blurring.
- The Quick Sell system has been added to the game, allowing you to quickly sell unnecessary items. Additionally, if you are a mobile user, selected items will be quickly transferred to the sales window, enabling fast bulk sales on mobile devices.
- A button has been added to the stats panel to view your game statistics. Your stats will increase as you stay in the game and kill monsters, and you will gain some bonuses.

- Fixed an issue where skill effects would not appear visually in some cases.
- A bug related to pet races has been fixed.
- The issue where closing your own market with ESC would cause a problem has been fixed.
- The 28th Level SSR Viking Hat has been renamed to SSR Horned Hat.
- Fixed an issue where gathering pets would sometimes get stuck.
- Fixed an issue where skills would not deal damage in some cases.

[Chat]
- A system text will now appear in the chat when you equip a dead pet.
- The background of the chat panel window has been darkened.
- An automatic chat translate system has been added to the game.
  + You can press the [?] icon at the end of messages to translate the last messages.

[Dungeon]
- When you enter a dungeon while in a group, you will now automatically enter the same dungeon with party members.
- If you enter a dungeon more than 5 times daily, you will be required to pay a small amount of gold for card rewards in that dungeon. You can receive 5 free card rewards per day from all dungeons.

[Quest]
- The Level 48 Ice Stone quest has been made easier, now requiring 20 Ice Stones instead of 40.

[Party]
- The party system has been completely revamped.
  + The level range required to join a party has been increased from 15 to 30.
  + If a monster killed in the party is 10 levels higher than you, you will earn double experience bonuses.
- You can now power-level lower-level players by taking them to higher-level maps and killing monsters for them.
  + The best way to power-level a player is to kill monsters 10-15 levels above them.
- The distance required for experience sharing in the party has been increased from 50 meters to 80 meters.
- The old party rules still apply to Dark levels.

[Sound]
- The sounds of monsters have been slightly increased.

[Map]
- The night theme of Honam Kingdom has been updated.
- The level requirement to transition to the Highlands map has been reduced from level 50 to 40.
- The level requirement to advance from Hellmond to the next city has been reduced from level 80 to 65.
- This allows lower-level players to be power-leveled in higher-level maps.

  + The Red Star buff now grants 5% attack power instead of 10%.
  + You will be able to move faster after using the Dividing Sky skill.

- Archer
  + With the Full Focus buff, your first hit will always be critical, and the cooldown time of the skill has been reduced.

- Ranger
  + The knockback effect of the Ultimate Laser Shot skill has been removed.
  + The damage ratio of the Potential Power skill has been reduced from 15% to 10%.
  + The issue where the Void Bomb skill would sometimes not take effect has been fixed.

- Wizard
  + The cast time of the Holy Beam skill has been sped up.
  + The Blackhole skill can now be used while moving, and its cast time has been sped up.
  + The cast time of the Paranoia skill has been slightly sped up, and you will now be able to move faster after using the skill.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559336/550b581855af1f350b2ed47e9ab9ff20a44af79f.png[/img]

[url=https://anisage.com/news.php?new_id=33]anisage.com[/url]

[GENERAL]
- Added nametag effects to Backrooms Entity, 200IQ, Youtuber, Streamer, and Cute Cat nametags.
- Fixed some translation errors.
- Added inventory, quests, and abilities buttons to the main screen on mobile.
- Daily pets can no longer level up.
- Now you can see the direction you are facing on the map panel.
- Removed the pot from the Lucky Wheel and added a short-term effective %100+ EXP Buff instead.
- While in Group and World chat, other texts will now be visible.
- DEX stat will no longer affect jumping height, resolving the issue of skill dodging in arenas.
- Added sound and visual effects for critical hits.
- Added an extra text indicating the gender requirement for gender-specific items.
- Greatly improved the issue of characters teleporting to the wrong location due to ping.
- Now you can easily teleport to Pyramid and Town Of Atarah maps from the "Traveling Commander" NPC at Tonka Castle.
- Now you can easily teleport to Honam Kingdom by pressing the town button at the bottom-left of your inventory.
- Weapons will now remain visible in FPS mode.
- Items obtained from fishes will now stack.

[GUILD]
- Added a guild search system, now family leaders can announce their guilds to players from the guild panel (G key), and players can apply to suitable families from the "Find Guild" list on the Guild Panel.
- Fixed an issue where the family description sometimes wouldn't appear.

[RATES]
- Slightly increased the drop rates of low-level quest items.

[RANKED ARENA]
- Fixed an issue with teleporting from the Arena to the town.
- Redesigned the Ranked Arena event to be 1v1.
- Expanded the battlefield of Ranked Arena.

[MATCHMAKING]
- If you encounter the same player again and win, you will now receive a lower Elo rating.

[FIXES]
- Fixed an issue with the Slime boss getting stuck inside walls.
- Fixed the stuck issue related to fishing.
- Fixed an issue on the Rabbit Hole map.
- Fixed an issue with the Steam Interface UI not opening.

[RAID]
- Slightly reduced the health of Azure Sky Dragon.

[QUEST]
- Added a button to the quest panel to view active quests.
- Added an exclamation mark above creatures for which you have active quests.
- Changed the direction arrow leading to quests; Yummy will now guide you.
- You can now select the target quest by clicking on the circular boxes in your quest panel to have Yummy accompany you on that quest.
- Mystic Swamp Patrol quest made easier.
- Morning Plains Patrol quest made easier.
- Dark Swamp Patrol quest made easier.
- The Farming profession quest will now only require planting seeds.
- Added the Daily Escape Room Event quest.

[MOB]
- Removed the ability of the Devil Wornak monster.

[INTERFACE]
- Redesigned the world portal interface.

[CLASSES]
- ARCHER
+ Removed the somersault animation from the Archer class's normal attack.
+ Increased the speed of the Archer class's Spiral Shot ability.
+ Changed the activation order of the Archer class's Whirling Arrow and Arrow Rain abilities.
+ The Archer class's Arrow Rain ability can now be aimed in a desired area.
+ Fixed the issue where the player appeared in the wrong place after stunning with the Archer class.

-WITCH
+ The Witch class's Lotus ability will now revive players instead of healing them. (Applies to Raid, Dungeons, etc., not valid in special maps.)
+ Reduced the cooldown duration of the Witch class's Grand Heal Aura ability from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.
+ Changed the activation order of the Witch class's Lotus and Grand Heal Aura abilities.
+ Updated the Witch class's Spiral Power attribute to provide 10%+ Damage.
+ Updated the Witch class's Magic Circle attribute to provide 10%+ Defense.
+ Now, the Witch class's Spiral Power and Magic Circle buffs can be used on other players as well.

[UPGRADE ITEM]
- New item enhancement system
+ Items up to +8 will no longer disappear when failing enhancement but will instead be damaged.
+ Damaged items will lose 2 enhancement levels.
+ You can buy Repair Tools from the fisherman to fix damaged items.
+ Obtain the required Fish Gems to purchase Repair Tools by crafting 3 Fishbones.
+ Use Repair Tools to repair your items at the blacksmith.

[CRAFT ITEM]
- Now, all craftable items list is displayed next to the craft window.
- When crafting, the crafted items will now stack in your inventory.

[EVENT]
- New Room Escape event added to the game.
- Event times are at server time: 03:00, 11:00, 19:00.
- The objective of the event is to navigate through trap-filled rooms and find the boss room within 10 minutes.
- There is power equalization in the event area, so each player will deal the same damage to every creature.
- When the boss is defeated, you can choose a card to win rare rewards.

[OPTIMIZATION]
- Server optimizations has been made.
- Game optimizations has been made.

[ANTI-CHEAT]
- AGN9 is updated, macro detection system is improved.

[AC SHOP]
- Oceanarium & Volcanium weapon sets added to the AC Shop.
- Hot Summer costume set added to the AC Shop.
- Repair Tool (Non-Tradable) added to the AC Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559336/63b5011c5509fd47ae95ef2e5ca58c1bddb24d95.png[/img]

[b]MATCHMAKING[/b]
- 1v1 and 2v2 matchmaking system is added to the game. Level 50 and above can join the Competitive match pool.
  + The queue system has two ranking systems, local rank and world ranking.
  + Your rank is permanent, you can rank up when you win a match and, rank down when you lose a match.
  + The world ranking is reset every month, prizes are giving to the top 10 players in that month.
  + Matches are Best of 5 rounds (BOF 5). The person who wins 3 rounds of 5 rounds wins the match.
  + The team that wins the match is rewarded with EXP.
  + If the match is not over until the time is up, it will be draw and neither team will score points.
  + Players who do not show enough effort & leave in the match will be temporary banned from matchmaking and trust-factor negatively effected.
  + The match is only active in CH1.
  + Premium matchmaking feature added.

     - Bronze: I, II, III

notes.title: 18.08.2022 - Update Notes
notes.content:
[ NEWS ]
* New Four Element Mystery Boxes have been added to all monsters. You can get rare items from these chests by dropping them from monsters.
* Automatic !pm system has been introduced by clicking on the names on the chat.
* For mobile users, now you can set target and lock the target with new UI buttons.
* We had some work on the mobile heating problems and the FPS limitation system has been added to the settings for mobile users.
* Temple of Twilight, Port Arvin and Beach maps and the NPCs who gave quests on those maps are now visible in the Map panel.
* Adventurer Camp III [Level 7 Quest] - Added a 7-day brown horse as reward.
* Skill reset book has been added to AC Shop.
* For collect pets, you will be able to choose which items they can collect.

[ FIXES ]
* Improved general performance optimizations.
* Health potions now regenerate your health over time.
* Levels and powers of Angry Mad Bull & Giant mobs have been lowered.
* The spawn rate of Miracle Stones has been reduced.
* Increased the strength of Sudden War bosses.
* Drop rates decreased.
* Now, you are not able to open stalls near NPCs due to blocking NPCs.
* When you collect fish it will automatically stack now.
* Bosses are no longer affected by knockback.
* Log-in problems to the game due to different time zones and time-zone based in-game errors have been fixed.
* Fixed the issue where the pet could not gain experience when the player reached the level limit.
* The crafting issue of bracelets and necklaces has been fixed.
* Rainbow Horse is now tradable.
* Daily rewards are only for 20+ level players now.
* It is written which stats they give to the seeds.

[ GUILD ]
* Guild wars has been made one-sided again, and the price of the flag of war and surrender has been increased.
* Players that are online in the game now shown as green in the guild panel.

[ RAID ]
* The access limit and register hours to raids on weekends have been removed, now you can register as many times as you want on weekends.
* Not only guild leaders, but also guild members with the highest authority can register raids.
* Raid Bosses are no longer affected by knockbacks.

[ PVP ]
* Reduced damage rates in PvPs.
* Health potions now regenerate your health over time.

[ BALANCING ]
* The skill cast time of the Wizard class has been reduced.
* The skill cast times of the Witch class have been reduced.
* The heal skills cooldown times of the Witch class have been reduced.

[ ANTI-CHEATING ]
* A warning system has been introduced against players using automation, bots, and macros. Now, a special question panel will appear in front of users who play suspiciously, and if the question is not answered, the user will receive a punishment.

[ COMMUNITY REPORTS ]
* Thanks to the @Akcan & @Arvy for reporting an important issue.
* Thanks to Aero World people for reports & suggestions.
